patches.value: Coordinate-splitting implementation extraction. Fin.insertNth is inverse to MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove. Use volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove and its inverse, verify the box image coordinatewise, and apply integral_prod_symm to the continuous function restricted to the compact product box. Only integrability on this finite-measure box is required, not global integrability of arbitrary d. k=0 uses the singleton finite product volume, not a separate convention.
